RAPIDAPI_KEY.name: RAPIDAPI_KEY
RAPIDAPI_KEY.description: RapidAPI key for the youtube-mp41 downloader. Required to fetch videos from a YouTube URL. Get one at https://rapidapi.com/ytjar/api/youtube-mp41 (the free tier works).

GEMINI_API_KEY.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key used for AI clip analysis, title/thumbnail generation and voice-over scripts. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. The dashboard also allows pasting a key per request.

MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.name: MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS
MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.description: Maximum number of video jobs processed in parallel. Each job uses significant CPU/RAM; raise only on larger Railway plans.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional. AWS access key for S3 upload of generated clips (gallery/backup). If unset, clips are only available via the local /videos endpoint.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional. AWS secret key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for S3 uploads.

AWS_REGION.name: AWS_REGION
AWS_REGION.description: Optional. AWS region for the S3 bucket used for clip uploads.

AWS_S3_BUCKET.name: AWS_S3_BUCKET
AWS_S3_BUCKET.description: Optional. S3 bucket name where generated clips are uploaded.

AWS_S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET.name: AWS_S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET
AWS_S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET.description: Optional. Public S3 bucket name whose objects get public URLs in generated pages.
